W01_baseline.docx.creation_method: New blank document in Microsoft Word, one editing session
controlled_actions: File > New > Blank document
Type exactly: The quick brown fox jumps over the dog.
File > Save As > W01_baseline.docx
Close Word
research_limitations: Word-native sample. RSID values are produced by Microsoft Word and are recorded as observed, not predicted.

results.expected: No claim; observe how many RSIDs a single Word session leaves.
results.note: The ground truth explicitly makes no validation claim about generator RSID behaviour.

W02_save_as_no_edit.docx.creation_method: W01 opened in Word and saved under a new name with no content change
controlled_actions: Open W01_baseline.docx in Word
Make no change
File > Save As > W02_save_as_no_edit.docx
Close Word
deliberate_deviations: Save operation without any content edit
research_limitations: Word-native sample. RSID values are produced by Microsoft Word and are recorded as observed, not predicted.

results.expected: No claim; RQ3 asks whether a save without edits adds an RSID.
results.note: The ground truth explicitly makes no validation claim about generator RSID behaviour.

W03_direct_edit.docx.creation_method: Byte-identical file copy of W01, edited in a second Word session

Replace the word "brown" with "red"
Place the cursor before "dog" and type "lazy "
Ctrl+S, close Word
research_limitations: Word-native sample. RSID values are produced by Microsoft Word and are recorded as observed, not predicted.

results.expected: No claim; expect new RSIDs on edited runs, recorded as observed.
results.note: The ground truth explicitly makes no validation claim about generator RSID behaviour.

W05_tracked_retained.docx.creation_method: Byte-identical copy of W01, edited with Track Changes on
controlled_actions: In File Explorer copy W01_baseline.docx and rename the copy W05_tracked_retained.docx
Open it in Word; Review > Track Changes ON
Double-click "brown" and press Delete (do not delete the space)
Type "red" in the same place
Ctrl+S, close Word WITHOUT accepting or rejecting
deliberate_deviations: Double-clicking 'brown' also selected the following space, so the tracked deletion is 'brown ' (with space).
A space was then typed after 'red' with Track Changes on, producing a second tracked insertion (' ').
Word recorded the signed-in Microsoft 365 account name ('Thabang Kubheka') as revision author instead of the configured user name 'Controlled Editor'.
research_limitations: Word-native sample. RSID values are produced by Microsoft Word and are recorded as observed, not predicted.
If Word selected the trailing space together with 'brown', the retained text will include it; record this as a deviation rather than editing the file.

results.note: The ground truth explicitly makes no validation claim about generator RSID behaviour.
